title: nft-marketplace
tagline: A market place to mint and purchase NFT's using the rinkeby testnet
description: This project is to be a market place just like opensea without the ridiculous fees as well as eventually become a platform independent market place. Currently this project achieves minting NFT's that were predefined images and metadata. It allows users to view their data the blockchain holds as well as mint nft's which is stored on the rinkeby blockchain.
how_its_made: This project uses web3.js for connecting metamask to the frontend dapp.  Next.js is being used for the frontend to display all the user's minted NFT's as well as all the NFT's the platform has to offer. The covalent api is being used to view the data about the address holder. IPFS is being used to store the nft data into a decentralized database. NFTPort is being used to mint the nft on the rinkeby testnet.
